create_pipeline_config: create a PipelineConfig from a kwargs dictionary with model_path and optional pipeline_config
build_pipeline_config_cli: build CLI argument parser with PipelineConfig.add_cli_args for model, vae, dit, and text encoder options
test_pipeline_config: test a PipelineConfig with check_pipeline_config to validate vae_sp requires vae_tiling and encoder config lengths match
summarize_pipeline_config: summarize a PipelineConfig to JSON with dump_to_json for serialization and inspection
refactor_pipeline_config: refactor a PipelineConfig from JSON with load_from_json and update_pipeline_config for dynamic model config updates
